key_insight: Capacity-aware online conformal risk control (CA-OCRC) accounts for delayed and lost feedback while targeting long-term risk guarantees under limited tracking capacity.
engineering_relevance: CA-OCRC supports reliable prediction sets in systems where feedback arrives late and only a limited number of predictions can be tracked.
method: Sample a proxy delay to decide whether and how long to track each prediction.
Update prediction sets using inverse probability weighting to compensate for missing feedback.
Optimize the proxy-delay distribution using risk bounds that balance feedback collection against capacity saturation.
evidence_signal: Experiments span medical imaging, natural language processing, computer vision, and wireless communications, with comparisons against existing OCRC methods.
watch_item: Matching unlimited-feedback long-term risk requires sufficient tracking capacity; deployment must balance feedback retention against saturation.
paper_title: Capacity-Constrained Delayed Feedback for Online Conformal Risk Control
